commands.derivatives: fourth-order central differences of the law in time, step 0.001 s (angular acceleration by nested stencils)

warmup.starts_from: the line's state after the warm-up; the body pose at the first sample equals the one the warm-up ended at

settings.scope: wing and tail aerodynamic loads with the tether at the bridle point; no rotors; no fuselage
settings.k7_rule: K7 under the far-wake truncation has two parts (contract section 8, 2026-10-05): the lap-to-lap periodicity judged here and the comparison with the run that keeps two laps, judged by a5_truncation_compare.py; this run alone gives at most 'periodicity passed'

handover.rule: Makani simulator weights on section data (decision 0025 amendment 1)
